title: A map matrix: data/map_matrices/<matrix>.json
description: A map matrix (archive a/0/0/9), which a zone's header names: a grid of the maps of its cells and, for the overworld's, of their zones. tools/data/map_matrix_data.py packs them in the order of data/constants/map_matrices.txt. A string value is the name of a constant from data/constants/ or include/constants/.

maps.description: The rows of the grid: each cell's map, a file of the map archive, or null for none

zones.description: For the overworld's matrices, the rows of each cell's zone, a ZONE_* constant, or null for none
